$comment: Single source of truth for content-type to frontend-URL mapping. Consumed by both apps/frontend (RTE internal link resolution, see lib/umbraco.ts) and apps/cms-umbraco (editor preview URL, see HeadlessPreviewUrlProvider.cs). When adding a new content type, add its pattern here.

patternSyntax.{<contentTypeAlias>.slug}: slug of an ancestor with that content type alias; resolver returns null/'#' if the ancestor cannot be found
